capabilities.title: Electronic Assembly
capabilities.summary: Assemble and test electronic components and circuits for prototyping and production.
capabilities.body:
# Electronic Assembly

Assemble and test electronic components and circuits for prototyping and production.

## Focus Areas

- Soldering and desoldering of components on PCBs.
- Testing and debugging of electronic circuits.
- Creating custom wiring harnesses and connectors for integration into larger systems.

capabilities.title: Metrology & Inspection
capabilities.summary: High-precision measurement, non-contact optical analysis, and inspection tools to rapidly evaluate physical prototypes.
capabilities.body:
# Metrology & Inspection

The Metrology & Inspection capability provides users with precise optical and digital measurement equipment to rapidly inspect fabricated parts, verify physical dimensions, and track surface deformation against CAD and simulation models.

## Focus Areas

- Non-contact 3D surface deformation and optical strain tracking (DIC).
- Precision dimensional measurement and quality inspection of fabricated parts.
- Physical validation of computational simulation models (FEA/CFD).

capabilities.title: Rapid Prototyping
capabilities.summary: Quickly create physical components for projects with short timelines or rapid iteration cycles.
capabilities.body:
# Rapid Prototyping

The Rapid Prototyping capability allows users to quickly create physical components for projects with short timelines or rapid iteration cycles. This capability is ideal for testing and validating designs before committing to full-scale production.

## Focus Areas

- 3D printing for rapid iteration of parts and assemblies.
- CNC machining for precision components.
- Laser cutting for quick fabrication of flat materials.

capabilities.title: Rigging & Construction
capabilities.summary: Rigid mounting frames, modular components, and prototyping platforms.
capabilities.body:
# Rigging & Construction

Provides the framework for portable and adaptable physical prototypes. The Rigging & Construction capability allows users to quickly assemble mounting platforms for a wide variety of applications. 

## Key Focus Areas
- Aluminum T-Slot fabrication (cutting, drilling).
- Readily-available assembly components (screws, nuts, brackets).
- Carbon fiber construction.

capabilities.title: Robotics & Automation
capabilities.summary: Compact robotics, motion control, and automated positioning systems for rapid prototyping of automated assembly and maintenance workflows.
capabilities.body:
# Robotics & Automation

The Robotics & Automation capability provides users with compact collaborative robots, motion controllers, and vision guidance sensors to rapidly prototype automated manipulation, assembly, inspection, and maintenance sequences.

## Focus Areas

- Collaborative robot (cobot) programming and end-effector integration.
- Vision-guided positioning and target tracking for automated inspection and maintenance.
- Quick-change tool interfaces (magnetic, pneumatic, mechanical) for multi-purpose robotic tasks.

tools.title: Benchtop Collaborative Robot Arm
tools.summary: Compact 6-axis collaborative robot arm with integrated safety sensors for automated manipulation, assembly, and tool-changing experiments.
tools.body:
# Benchtop Collaborative Robot Arm

Compact 6-axis collaborative robot arm used in the DTC Model Shop for prototyping automated pick-and-place routines, testing custom 3D-printed end-effectors, and developing automated maintenance workflows.

## Features
- 6-degree-of-freedom articulated arm with torque feedback safety sensors for cage-free operation.
- Standardized tool flange interface supporting quick-change magnetic and pneumatic tool changers.
- Programmable digital/analog I/O and Ethernet interface for integrating grippers and sensors.
- Teach pendant and Python/ROS API support for rapid trajectory and motion sequence development.

tools.title: Programmable DC Bench Power Supply & Analyzer
tools.summary: Precision multi-channel programmable DC power supply with real-time current draw logging and power profiling.
tools.body:
# Programmable DC Bench Power Supply & Analyzer

Benchtop multi-channel programmable DC power supply used in the DTC Model Shop to deliver regulated voltage rails and measure dynamic power consumption across electronic prototypes and edge compute hardware.

## Features
- Multi-channel isolated DC outputs with precise voltage and current limit regulation.
- High-resolution real-time voltage, current, and wattage monitoring.
- Dynamic data logging for profiling power spikes, idle power, and watt-per-inference metrics.
- Over-voltage and over-current protection (OVP/OCP) to safeguard sensitive development boards.

tools.title: Digital Image Correlation (DIC) Optical System
tools.summary: High-speed stereoscopic camera system for real-time 3D optical surface deformation and strain tracking.
tools.body:
# Digital Image Correlation (DIC) Optical System

Stereoscopic optical metrology tool used in the DTC Model Shop to capture high-speed 3D surface deformation, strain distribution, and displacement fields without physical contact.

## Features
- High-resolution dual stereo camera setup with synchronized high-speed capture.
- Real-time full-field 3D strain mapping and displacement tracking under load.
- Direct export of optical deformation mesh data for comparison against FEA simulation models.
- Non-contact measurement ideal for lightweight composite, carbon fiber, and 3D-printed components.

tools.title: Digital Inspection Microscope
tools.summary: High-magnification digital stereo microscope with integrated HD camera for optical surface inspection, solder joint validation, and micro-defect analysis.
tools.body:
# Digital Inspection Microscope

High-magnification digital optical microscope used in the DTC Model Shop for non-destructive visual inspection, fine-pitch PCB solder joint verification, and real-time process monitoring.

## Features
- Continuous optical zoom with high-resolution HD camera feed for live display.
- Dimmable LED ring illumination for glare-free surface and feature inspection.
- Real-time video output and image capture for micro-defect documentation and layer analysis.
- Adjustable boom stand adaptable to desktop 3D printers, PCB workbenches, and inspection fixtures.

tools.title: FDM 3D Printer Bank
tools.summary: High-resolution FDM 3D printer for rapid prototyping and small-scale production.
tools.body:
# FDM 3D Printer Bank

High-resolution FDM 3D printers for rapid prototyping and small-scale production.

### Features
- Multiple FDM 3D printers for parallel prototyping.
- High-resolution printing for detailed parts.

tools.title: Industrial Metal Chop Saw
tools.summary: 14-inch 15-Amp abrasive chop saw for precision stock cutting of structural steel, struts, and framing.
tools.body:
# Industrial Metal Chop Saw

Heavy-duty physical shop tool used in the DTC Model Shop for preparing structural aluminum, struts, steel or carbon fiber tubing, and custom rigging brackets.

### Features
- 15 Amp 5.5 HP motor
- 14-inch abrasive wheel
- Quick-lock vise for fast material clamping

tools.title: Oscilloscope
tools.summary: High-precision oscilloscope for analyzing electronic signals and waveforms.
tools.body:
# Oscilloscope

High-precision electronic test equipment used in the DTC Model Shop for visualizing voltage signals, troubleshooting PCB circuits, and analyzing signal integrity.

### Features
- Multi-channel digital storage oscilloscope for real-time signal capture.
- High sampling rate and bandwidth for signal integrity and timing analysis.
- Hardware serial bus decoding (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN) for digital communication debugging.
- Automated measurement and waveform math capabilities.

tools.title: PCB CNC Milling & Prototyping Station
tools.summary: Precision PCB milling machine for rapid in-house prototyping of single- and double-sided printed circuit boards.
tools.body:
# PCB CNC Milling & Prototyping Station

High-precision desktop CNC milling machine used in the DTC Model Shop for rapid in-house prototyping of single- and double-sided printed circuit boards (PCBs), trace isolation milling, and hole drilling.

## Features
- Rapid isolation milling and contour routing for copper-clad laminates (FR-4, Rogers).
- Automatic tool change and high-speed spindle for micro-drilling through-holes and vias.
- Integrated height sensing for precise copper isolation depth without chemical etching.
- Supports Gerber and Excellon drill files generated by standard EDA packages (Altium, KiCad, Eagle).

tools.title: Robotic Vision & Positioning Camera System
tools.summary: Industrial smart camera system for robot guidance, 2D/3D part positioning, and automated inspection alignment.
tools.body:
# Robotic Vision & Positioning Camera System

Compact 2D/3D industrial vision sensor used in the DTC Model Shop for guiding robot motion, recognizing components, and aligning automated inspection probes.

## Features
- On-board vision processor for pattern matching, edge detection, and AprilTag/QR code recognition.
- Direct communication interface with cobot controllers for closed-loop vision guidance.
- Integrated LED lighting and adjustable focus lens for variable working distances.
- High-frame-rate capture for dynamic tracking and automated part alignment.

tools.title: Soldering & Rework Station
tools.summary: Precision temperature-controlled soldering and hot air rework station for wires, through-hole, SMD components, and desoldering.
tools.body:
# Soldering & Rework Station

Precision electronic assembly and rework station used in the DTC Model Shop for wire harness fabrication, through-hole PCB assembly, surface-mount (SMD) soldering, and circuit component desoldering/repair.

## Features
- Dual-function temperature-controlled soldering iron and hot air rework tool.
- Precision tips for fine-pitch surface-mount (SMD) components and dense PCB assemblies.
- High-capacity iron for heavy gauge wiring and wire harness soldering.
- Integrated vacuum desoldering pump and wick for rapid component removal and board repair.
- Variable temperature and airflow controls suitable for leaded and lead-free alloys.
- ESD-safe design to protect sensitive microelectronics and ICs during assembly.

tools.title: High-Resolution Thermal Imaging Camera
tools.summary: Non-contact infrared thermal camera for full-field heat mapping, thermal throttling analysis, and PCB hot-spot inspection.
tools.body:
# High-Resolution Thermal Imaging Camera

Precision radiometric infrared camera used in the DTC Model Shop for real-time thermal analysis of active electronics, high-power edge compute modules, and mechanical components under load.

## Features
- High thermal sensitivity and radiometric temperature mapping for identifying localized hot spots.
- Non-contact thermal imaging ideal for evaluating heatsinks, cooling fan shrouds, and enclosure airflow.
- Video recording and thermal data logging for transient thermal dissipation analysis.
- Color palette overlays and radiometric image export for thermal simulation validation.

projects.title: Airframe Arm Deflection & Strain Test Bench
projects.summary: A custom structural test fixture constructed using DTC Model Shop rapid prototyping, framing, and electronic tools to validate UAV airframe arm deflection against FEA predictions via DIC optical metrology.
projects.body:
# Airframe Arm Deflection & Strain Test Bench

- **Physical:** A custom mechanical test jig constructed using aluminum T-slot framing and 3D-printed mounts, holding a 3D-printed or carbon fiber UAV arm under static and dynamic motor thrust loads.
        
- **Digital/Metrology:** Utilizes high-resolution stereoscopic cameras (DIC) to track optical surface deformation in real-time, comparing empirical deflection data against Ansys FEA predictions.
    
- **Member Interest:** Optical metrology (Trilion), simulation validation (Ansys), structural materials testing (UDRI).

projects.title: Closed-Loop Additive Manufacturing In-Situ Metrology Rig
projects.summary: An FDM 3D printer instrumented with a thermal imaging camera and optical inspection optics for in-situ monitoring of layer deposition, thermal void formation, and defect detection.
projects.body:
# Closed-Loop Additive Manufacturing In-Situ Metrology Rig

- **Physical:** A desktop 3D printer instrumented with a thermal camera and optical microscope aimed at the print nozzle.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Detects layer misalignments or thermal void formations during the build and feeds layer-by-layer defect maps back into CAD/FEA software to predict part strength loss before completion.
    
- **Member Interest:** Smart manufacturing (ARCTOS, Sinclair), digital thread integration (AFMC DTO, UDRI), physics simulation (Ansys).

projects.title: Modular Quick-Change Cobot Maintenance Tooling
projects.summary: Custom 3D-printed quick-change end-effectors and vision-guided tooling for benchtop collaborative robots (cobots) in automated maintenance and inspection tasks.
projects.body:
# Modular Quick-Change Cobot Maintenance Tooling

- **Physical:** A benchtop cobot arm fitted with custom 3D-printed end-effectors (grippers, inspection probes, or fastener drivers) using magnetic or pneumatic tool changers.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Vision-guided positioning for automated inspection or component replacement tasks.
    
- **Member Interest:** Automated sustainment and repair (AFRL RSO), smart manufacturing workforce training (Sinclair, NPower).

projects.title: Edge AI Model Benchmarking & Thermal Test Fixture
projects.summary: An actively cooled, sensorized test rack for benchmarking low-power edge compute modules, measuring real-time current draw, thermal performance, and inference latency across vision AI models.
projects.body:
# Edge AI Model Benchmarking & Thermal Test Fixture

- **Physical:** An actively cooled, sensorized test rack holding multiple low-power edge compute modules, instrumented to monitor real-time current draw and thermal generation.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Displays live frame rates, watt-per-inference metrics, and latency across different optimized vision architectures (e.g., YOLO variants vs. quantized models).
    
- **Member Interest:** Algorithm optimization (MathWorks), edge hardware evaluation (IBM), defense venture acceleration (Sightline Ventures).

projects.title: MOSA-Compliant Spart Payload Pod
projects.summary: A modular, MOSA-compliant payload for a custom sensing application.
projects.body:
# MOSA-Compliant Smart Payload Pod

- **Physical:** A 3D-printed, quick-release modular payload enclosure housing custom PCBs (power distribution, sensor signal conditioning) that connects via a standardized physical and electrical pinout interface.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Automatically broadcasts its payload descriptor and telemetry schema upon connection to an onboard edge computer.
    
- **Member Interest:** MOSA hardware integration (TangramFlex, Psoas), avionics retrofits (Field Aerospace, Sumaria), custom fabrication (Sinclair, ARCTOS).

projects.title: Multi-Modal Acoustic-Visual Threat Detection Pod
projects.summary: A weatherized 3D-printed sensor pod combining a MEMS microphone array, optical camera, and edge AI processor for real-time acoustic-visual threat classification and camera slewing.
projects.body:
# Multi-Modal Acoustic-Visual Threat Detection Pod

- **Physical:** A compact, weatherized 3D-printed housing combining a MEMS microphone array, a compact optical camera, and an embedded edge processor (e.g., Jetson or NXP) on a custom power board.
    
- **Digital/AI:** Runs lightweight acoustic classification (e.g., drone motor frequency or impact detection) to trigger directional camera slewing and target segmentation models.
    
- **Member Interest:** Advanced sensing/MASINT (US MASINT Foundation), edge compute infrastructure (IBM, HumanIT), tactical deployment (Army Cyber Command).
